caption: The video captures a hydraulic press in the middle of crushing a hammer against a plain light-gray background. A top platen wrapped in diagonal yellow-and-black hazard stripes descends steadily onto a matching striped base platen. Standing on the base between the platens is a black hammer head, its wooden handle with a red-painted end protruding horizontally to the left. The shiny curved metal lip of the hammer, caught directly beneath the descending platen, is progressively compressed and flattened, its thin upward curve thickening and creasing as the gap closes. As the striped platen lowers, the bare silver cylinder above it becomes increasingly visible at the upper edge. Under the load the black head's upper hook is pressed downward, its top sinking along with the flattened lip while the column itself stays upright. The wooden handle and the bottom platen remain fixed throughout, and the press continues its slow descent without reaching a final state.
